keySentence: First, he cut the leather and left it ready.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The shoemaker did not give up. He prepared the leather. He left it on the table. First, he cut the leather and left it ready.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The shoemaker had only one chance left to make shoes. He did not give up even though he was very poor. First, he cut the leather and left it ready on the table. He shaped each piece with great care and love. He placed everything neatly and went to bed. Something wonderful was about to happen while he slept.
